summary: End-to-end testing of Mandiri POS. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests passed covering auth, categories, products, sales checkout (stock reduction + profit/change calc), reports (summary/sales-over-time/top/by-category/payment-methods/low-stock), user management and role gating. Frontend: full UI flow via Playwright - admin login, POS product grid + search + category filter, add-to-cart/qty +/-/remove, checkout with discount+cash+change display, receipt dialog, Products CRUD (create/delete TEST_UI_Product), Categories/Reports/Riwayat navigation, create cashier user, log in as cashier, verify no admin nav items visible, verify redirect from /reports to /, cleanup. Everything works.

minor.issue: When ADMIN_PASSWORD env is changed, seed updates hash - good. But if existing admin was created with a different email seed (admin@example.com fallback) and env later changes to pranataamstrong@gmail.com, both admins can coexist. Currently only pranataamstrong@gmail.com exists so not a problem.
Stock is decremented without validating sufficient stock (allows negative stock). Not a blocker for MVP but consider guard.
Uses ObjectId(payload['sub']) inside try/except InvalidTokenError; a malformed sub would raise bson.errors.InvalidId leading to 500 instead of 401. Consider catching.

ui_bugs.issue: navigate() called synchronously during render (line 18: `if (user) navigate('/', {replace:true})`). Produces React console error 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component'. Wrap in useEffect.

ui_bugs.component: DialogContent (all dialogs: payment, receipt, product, user, etc.)
ui_bugs.issue: Missing DialogDescription / aria-describedby - Radix a11y warning in console on every dialog open.

action_items: Fix Login.js to use useEffect for redirect when user already logged in (removes React 'setState in render' warning).
Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby='undefined' visually hidden) to Dialog components to remove a11y warning.
(Optional) Validate stock availability in POST /api/sales before decrementing to avoid negative stock.
(Optional) Catch bson.errors.InvalidId in get_current_user to return 401 instead of 500 for malformed tokens.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.js side-effect navigate during render is a React anti-pattern (produces warning); use useEffect.
server.py checkout does not check stock >= qty before $inc -q; may result in negative stock.
server.py get_current_user should also catch InvalidId when payload['sub'] is not a valid ObjectId.
All routes correctly use /api prefix; JWT and role-based access properly enforced (verified via tests).
MongoDB _id is properly excluded via serialize() helper on all endpoints - good.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 3 categories and 10 products on startup if products collection empty. Tests created/deleted TEST_-prefixed data (cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs in ~4s with pytest-xdist. All 20 tests pass. Frontend Playwright flow verified: login->POS->cart->checkout->receipt->Products CRUD->create cashier->cashier login->role gating (no admin nav, /reports redirects to /). Only minor console warnings remain (Login navigate-in-render, Dialog a11y).
